stages.discovery: A cluster of leaning headstones breaks up the tall grass, most of them worn smooth by rain and time. One newer grave sits apart from the others, its marker still sharp-edged, a wilted wreath tied to it with twine that hasn't yet rotted through.

choices.label: Tend the Newest Grave
choices.description: Straighten the wreath, clear the weeds
choices.outcome: You pull the weeds back from the marker and set the wreath straight. Whoever they were, someone still remembers - if only for a little while longer.

choices.label: Search the Older Graves
choices.description: Some of these look old enough to have been robbed before - Perception check

check.success_outcome: You spot a tarnished ring half-buried by a collapsed headstone - whoever picked this place clean before you missed it. You pocket it and try not to think too hard about where it's been.
check.failure_outcome: You turn over what's left of the older markers but whatever this ground still holds, it isn't giving it up to you today.

choices.label: Leave the Dead Undisturbed
choices.description: ESC also cancels - some ground shouldn't be walked on
choices.outcome: You skirt the edge of the graveyard and keep the stones between you and the road behind you.
